dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: EXEC SQL absent, MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET pattern typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt billing system - patient list screen for monthly billing/collection (syunou = collection/receipt)
purpose.summary: ORCGS10 is a screen program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that displays a patient list for a given billing month. It initialises the screen by querying the syunou (collection) and patient information tables, sorts the patient list, and handles user navigation events such as clicking buttons and selecting patients from the list.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (28 copybooks) for screen layouts and DB access
MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET event-driven screen handling (ORCA MCP framework)
Bubble-sort implemented in COBOL for patient list ordering
Japanese text in comments and string literals (EUC-JP/Shift-JIS encoded)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple screen area copybooks
BINARY PIC S9(9) for row index
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in a Japanese encoding (likely EUC-JP decoded as latin-1), causing mojibake in comments and string literals. This is a production component of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely - ORCA uses its own MCP event framework rather than CICS, but the pattern is equivalent (event-driven screen program).
